limits: All four verdicts are graded: the verifier applied the combined attack diff (no tamper signature hit) and ran each task's own `go test` target, which exited rc=1 (verifier_decision `rc=1 runner=RUNNER=go-test`; graded_failure names the failing test). None rests on a tamper refusal.

attacks_executed is 8 of 14 for every row: tamper_tracked_conftest, tamper_sitecustomize and the four tamper_source_* attacks skip on non-Python packages (attacks_not_executed). Clean here means the eight applicable v1.4.0 attacks did not earn reward on a graded Go run; it is not evidence about the six Python-only attacks.

The verifier's baseline step has no consumer for the go-test runner (verifier/baseline.log: `no baseline consumer for runner go-test`), so baseline_runner is null for all four rows. The graded rc does not depend on it.

Docker Desktop was again intermittently slow on this host (load average 9-15). Harbor's 10 s `docker info` preflight failed four times for 000431 before any trial existed; a `docker info` probe every 2 s beside attempt 5 (01:13-01:28 UTC) took 0.4-30.5 s per call, over 10 s on 22 of 111 calls, including six 30 s timeouts, so the gate's two fast calls did not guarantee a fast preflight seconds later. 000427 attempt 1 wrote an unscored census row because the compose lock confirmation timed out after the image pull and before any attack ran. Each was retried as the same Docker-responsiveness preflight class, as HAR-292/298 did. Every failure is preserved under <task>/.failed-attempt<N>/ and listed in prior_attempts; census-rows.jsonl keeps every row and each verdict here is from the final attempt only. A pre-launch gate waited for two consecutive fast `docker info` calls before every attempt (docker_gate_seconds) and is excluded from wall.

The slice spanned two owner runs at the same commit 5d4387a98. The first HAR-301 run ran 000048, 000208, both 000427 attempts and 000431 attempts 1-2, then hit its 5400 s timeout; its driver process had already launched 000431 attempt 3, which failed at the same preflight. Attempts 4 and 5 ran from the second owner run's worktree. All final jobs record repository.commit 5d4387a98 with an empty uncommitted diff.

wall_seconds is per final attempt and includes uv startup and docker-lock acquisition; no other card held the lock during these runs (lock_wait_seconds 0). Every task pulled its base image cold (none cached before; each removed after). totals.wall_minutes_including_timed_prior_attempts adds the timed failed attempts.

mimo-census's own post-run process-job hook wrote process-job-error.txt in each job (`Processed report input must be outside the results home when publishing`, because the jobs dir sits under the results home); the explicit process-job publish above then succeeded for all five trial-bearing jobs and the published copies carry processed/ reports.

Manifest verify stays unverified: the oracle and nop control cells that pending-controls.json still owes for these four rows, and fix-content cells, were not run here; a ladder cell alone cannot make a row pass.
